task_scope: New local terminal todo app: add/list/done and persistence, Python standard library only; no requested expert pipeline or CLI shape.
design_assessment: Single argparse entry point directly loads a JSON list, performs the selected operation and prints output; no service/repository/factory, duplicate state, pluggable backend or config framework.
load_tasks/save_tasks encapsulate concrete file I/O; the application-boundary catch retains the original exception message and returns a nonzero status.
Temporary-file replacement has a present data-preservation purpose; no speculative retries or recovery fallback are present.
One why comment explains atomic replacement. Fields map directly to current id/title/done behavior.

Some nonrequested behavior remains: trimming titles, idempotent repeated completion and stored-data schema checks; the model also checked several invalid inputs. These were bounded in one check run, not an expanding review pipeline.
observed_flow: Main conversation implemented directly; no spawn_agent, plan, research/architecture/review/simplify dispatch or develop read observed in native trace.
One apply_patch created the two deliverables; one Python heredoc checked requested paths plus several extra validation cases; final read of delivered files inspected the result.
No later edit or mandatory cleanup rewrite was made. No data file or temporary test directory remains in the delivered project.
limits: One small greenfield task is evidence of completing this scoped result, not a comparative speedup or a cross-model/complex-project guarantee.
Five roles were registered by overrides, but none was invoked; this experiment does not prove their runtime behavior.
Independent acceptance tests only the requested happy path using the delivered public CLI; it does not prove absence of unknown defects or concurrent-write safety.
The ordinary user config emitted two existing ignored-field warnings (disable_response_storage and network_access); raw warnings are preserved and no base config was changed.
